title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Deposit and Payment Terms Schedule
content:
Billing office schedule of the Fire & Smoke Mitigation self-pay deposit and of the payment terms that set the due date of the final invoice, by tier and by funding source.

## Terms

- Self-pay deposit: Deposit a self-pay customer pays before cleaning starts, USD.
- Self-pay payment terms: Days after the final invoice date by which a self-pay balance is due, calendar days.
- Insurance payment terms: Days after the final invoice date by which an insurance-funded balance is due, calendar days.

## Schedule

| Tier | Self-pay deposit (USD) | Payment terms, self-pay (calendar days) | Payment terms, insurance-funded (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Smoke Odor Response | 250.00 | 15 | 45 |
| Light Smoke and Soot Cleanup | 500.00 | 15 | 45 |
| Moderate Fire and Smoke Cleanup | 1000.00 | 15 | 45 |
| Heavy Fire Cleanup | 2000.00 | 15 | 45 |
| Structural Fire Large Loss | 3500.00 | 15 | 45 |
| Commercial Fire Large Loss | 5000.00 | 30 | 45 |

## Notes

- A job is funded either as self-pay or under an insurance claim; the self-pay column applies to the first and the insurance-funded column to the second.
- The deposit rises with every tier, from 250.00 on Smoke Odor Response to 5000.00 on Commercial Fire Large Loss.
- Self-pay terms are 15 calendar days on ranks 1 to 5 and 30 calendar days on Commercial Fire Large Loss; insurance-funded terms are 45 calendar days on every tier.

## Hypothetical reading

A hypothetical self-pay Heavy Fire Cleanup job reads a deposit of 2000.00 and self-pay terms of 15 calendar days; the same tier funded under an insurance claim reads terms of 45 calendar days.
